learning_need: Broad professional development for effective online and blended teaching
decision_rationale: Take your teaching online is the strongest broad Education & Teaching survivor. Its 24-hour eight-week route combines research, weekly practice, accessibility, technology selection, collaboration, online assessment, quizzes and professional reflection, giving it substantially more depth and independent-study structure than the short CPD alternatives.
marginal_value: Adds the category's broadest teacher-development route with strong practice and accessibility.
provider_concentration_notes: OpenLearn is represented elsewhere, but this course serves a distinct professional-teaching role and is the strongest broad option.
coverage_notes: Becomes the general teacher-development anchor; focused classroom methodology and teacher-educator development remain separate roles.

learning_need: Current classroom resource evaluation and adaptation for English-language teaching
decision_rationale: How to adapt resources is the strongest current classroom-methodology CPD survivor. Its 2026–27 route moves from evaluating resources to adapting lesson plans for context/inclusion and using learners as classroom resources, supported by a workbook and free certificate.
marginal_value: Adds direct classroom-design transfer in a current compact professional-development format.
provider_concentration_notes: British Council has four survivors, so only clearly differentiated roles are retained; this is the strongest classroom-methodology option.
coverage_notes: Represents practical ELT classroom design without promoting every adjacent British Council CPD module.

learning_need: Teacher-educator development, communities of practice and teacher autonomy
decision_rationale: Helping teachers to learn serves a different audience from classroom CPD. Its focus on teacher learning, training, communities of practice, collaborative learning and self-directed professional development gives it a distinct teacher-educator role, reinforced by workbook reflection and action planning.
marginal_value: Adds professional-development leadership for educators who train or support other teachers.
provider_concentration_notes: A second British Council admission is justified because the learner role is materially different from classroom resource adaptation.
coverage_notes: Covers teacher-educator practice rather than another classroom-methodology variant.

learning_need: Communicative and task-based classroom design for English-language teaching
decision_rationale: Communicative tasks is a strong current CPD course, but its classroom-methodology role overlaps substantially with How to adapt resources. With provider concentration already high, the slightly stronger and broader resource-adaptation route offers more marginal core value.
marginal_value: Useful task-based specialist practice, but insufficient differentiation for a third British Council slot.
provider_concentration_notes: British Council concentration is a material reason to prune adjacent short CPD courses.
coverage_notes: Task-based teaching remains available as a reviewed specialist supplement.

learning_need: Grammar, functional language and language-systems pedagogy for English teachers
decision_rationale: Understanding language systems is coherent and useful, but it is narrower subject-pedagogy CPD and less practice-rich than the selected resource-adaptation route. Promoting it would over-represent adjacent British Council modules.
marginal_value: Adds specialist grammar/language-systems pedagogy but limited broad teacher-development coverage.
provider_concentration_notes: Provider concentration is decisive after two clearly distinct British Council roles are retained.
coverage_notes: Remains a useful reviewed specialist for English-language teachers.

learning_need: Intermediate pedagogy for diagnosing and redesigning difficult threshold concepts
decision_rationale: Teaching and learning tricky topics is substantial and practice-led, but its 2019 evidence base materially lowers current recommendation and its general teacher-development role overlaps the stronger, more accessible Take your teaching online route.
marginal_value: Adds threshold-concept specialization but insufficient current marginal value for the core.
provider_concentration_notes: OpenLearn concentration is secondary; the main issue is currentness and overlap.
coverage_notes: Remains a strong specialist option for educators redesigning a known difficult topic.
